source: GPT-2 moved layer normalization to the input of each sub-block and added a final normalization after the last block. [4] GPT-3 retained GPT-2’s pre-normalization architecture. [18] LLaMA later combined Pre-Norm with ZXNAME0000XZ, ZXNAME0001XZ, and RoPE. [8]
zh: GPT-2 将层归一化移至每个子块的输入，并在最后一个块之后添加最终归一化。 [4] GPT-3保留了GPT-2的预标准化架构。 [18] LLaMA 后来将 Pre-Norm 与 ZXNAME0000XZ、ZXNAME0001XZ 和 RoPE 结合起来。 [8]
